response.sql: WITH o AS (SELECT order_id, AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS REAL)) AS avg_qty FROM Order_Items GROUP BY order_id), t AS (SELECT AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS REAL)) AS overall_avg FROM Order_Items) SELECT o.order_id, o.avg_qty AS order_avg_quantity, o.avg_qty - t.overall_avg AS diff_from_overall FROM o CROSS JOIN t WHERE t.overall_avg IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (o.avg_qty - t.overall_avg) IS NULL, o.avg_qty - t.overall_avg DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: product_quantity is stored as text, so it is cast to a number; NULL quantities are ignored by AVG. Non-numeric text, if any, would be treated as 0 by the cast.
The overall average is the average over all Order_Items rows (each item weighted equally), not the average of the per-order averages.
Orders whose quantities are all NULL are kept, with a NULL average and NULL difference, and sorted last, as long as the overall average exists.

alternatives.interpretation: The overall average is the mean of the per-order averages, so each order is weighted equally.
